# Deslop checks

<!-- Generated by `mise run checks:update` from the rule files. Don't edit by hand. -->

Each section is one check.
`%s` stands for the flagged text.

## `Deslop.AIBuzzWords`

```text
Level: warning
'%s' is an overused word in AI-generated writing.
Fix: Replace with a synonym or restructure the sentence to avoid it.
Example: "Don't disable until the release lands." -> "Don't disable until after release."
```

## `Deslop.AIReferrerParams`

```text
Level: error
A chatbot referrer/UTM parameter ('%s') leaked into this URL.
Fix: strip the tracking parameter before publishing the link.
```

## `Deslop.AnaphoraRun`

```text
Level: suggestion
3+ sentences in a row open with the same word.
Fix: vary sentence openers.
```

## `Deslop.AnnouncementOpener`

```text
Level: error
'%s' is a press-release opener, not a plain statement.
Fix: say what changed, without the announcement framing.
Example: "We're excited to announce the new parser." -> "The new parser ships in this release."
```

## `Deslop.BoldFirstBullet`

```text
Level: suggestion
%d list items in a row open with a bold lead-in.
Fix: use bold for the exceptional item only, not every item.
```

## `Deslop.BusinessJargon`

```text
Level: warning
Use the plain word ('%s') instead of the corporate-jargon phrase ('%s').
```

## `Deslop.ChatbotArtifacts`

```text
Level: error
'%s' is chatbot correspondence, not document prose.
Fix: delete it, or rewrite the surrounding text as prose.
```

## `Deslop.CopulaAvoidance`

```text
Level: warning
Use the plain verb ('%s') instead of the dressed-up one ('%s').
```

## `Deslop.CurlyQuotes`

```text
Level: error
Use a straight quote ('%s') instead of the curly quote ('%s').
```

## `Deslop.DespiteChallenges`

```text
Level: warning
'%s' is the rigid "faces challenges, but the future looks bright" closing formula.
Fix: name the actual challenge and its actual stakes, or cut the section.
```

## `Deslop.EmDashAside`

```text
Level: warning
%d em dashes in one sentence bracket an aside.
Fix: give the aside its own sentence, or cut it.
```

## `Deslop.EmDashDocumentLimit`

```text
Level: error
%d em dashes in one document.
Fix: use commas, parentheses, or separate sentences.
```

## `Deslop.EmDashEmphasis`

```text
Level: warning
Em dashes ('—') are overused in AI-generated writing to emphasize clauses or parallelisms. They are also a smell for overly complex sentence structure.
Fix: Consider adjusting tone or simplifying sentence structure to eliminate the need for an em dash.
```

## `Deslop.EmDashParagraphLimit`

```text
Level: error
%d em dashes in one paragraph.
Fix: use commas, parentheses, or separate sentences.
```

## `Deslop.Emoji`

```text
Level: warning
Emoji are not appropriate for professional and formal writing. AI-generated writing tends to include them regardless of context.
Fix: Remove the emoji or replace with an actual word.
```

## `Deslop.EmphasisCrutch`

```text
Level: error
'%s' asserts emphasis instead of earning it with evidence.
Fix: cut it, or replace it with the specific detail that earns the emphasis.
```

## `Deslop.ExclamationDensity`

```text
Level: suggestion
%d exclamation points in one paragraph.
Fix: keep at most one, and let the content carry the emphasis.
```

## `Deslop.FalseAgency`

```text
Level: warning
This gives an abstraction ('%s') human agency it doesn't have.
Fix: name who or what actually did this.
```

## `Deslop.FalseInclusivity`

```text
Level: error
This false-inclusivity opener flatters every reader instead of saying who this is actually for.
Fix: name the actual audience, or cut the opener.
```

## `Deslop.FalseRange`

```text
Level: warning
This isn't a real range -- it's an abstract-noun pair or chain dressed up as a spectrum.
Fix: say what actually changed, concretely.
```

## `Deslop.FillerTransitions`

```text
Level: error
'%s' is filler that adds no information.
Fix: cut it.
```

## `Deslop.GenericOpening`

```text
Level: error
'%s' is a stock scene-setting opener that fits any topic.
Fix: open with the actual point instead.
```

## `Deslop.GrandioseStakes`

```text
Level: warning
'%s' inflates this change's actual stakes.
Fix: state what actually changed, at its actual scale.
```

## `Deslop.HashtagBlock`

```text
Level: error
A run of social-media hashtags doesn't belong in this document.
Fix: delete them, or replace with real keywords/tags in the document's own convention.
```

## `Deslop.HedgingDensity`

```text
Level: suggestion
%d hedges in one paragraph.
Fix: keep the strongest one, and commit to the rest.
```

## `Deslop.InventedConcept`

```text
Level: warning
'%s' reads as an invented concept dressed up as an established one.
Fix: cite the source if it's a real term, or just describe the thing plainly.
```

## `Deslop.KnowledgeCutoff`

```text
Level: error
'%s' is a model disclaiming its own knowledge, not document prose.
Fix: state what's known, or cut the sentence.
```

## `Deslop.ListicleInProse`

```text
Level: suggestion
This ordinal ("The first/second/...") belongs in a list, not a sentence.
Fix: convert to an actual list, or drop the ordinal framing.
```

## `Deslop.MagicAdverbs`

```text
Level: warning
'%s' asserts an effect instead of demonstrating it.
Fix: cut it, or replace it with the specific evidence that earns it.
```

## `Deslop.MarketingAdjectives`

```text
Level: warning
'%s' is an adjective that sells rather than describes.
Fix: replace with a specific, factual description.
Example: "Powerful search" becomes "search that handles 10M records in under 200ms."
```

## `Deslop.MetaReference`

```text
Level: warning
'%s' narrates the document's own structure instead of writing content.
Fix: cut it and get to the point.
```

## `Deslop.NegativeParallelism`

```text
Level: error
This sets up a false "not X, but Y" contrast.
Fix: state the point directly, without the negative setup.
```

## `Deslop.PairedAdjectives`

```text
Level: warning
A paired 'X yet/but Y' adjective contrast asserts a tension instead of showing it.
Fix: cut one adjective, or show the specific tradeoff.
```

## `Deslop.PedagogicalVoice`

```text
Level: error
'%s' is a classroom-teacher framing device.
Fix: cut it and go straight to the content.
```

## `Deslop.RhetoricalSetup`

```text
Level: warning
This is a scripted rhetorical setup-and-payoff, not a real question.
Fix: state the point directly, in one sentence.
```

## `Deslop.ScareQuotes`

```text
Level: suggestion
This scare-quoted word signals ironic distance instead of a real quotation.
Fix: cut the quotes and commit to the word, or attribute it to its source.
```

## `Deslop.SentenceRhythm`

```text
Level: suggestion
4 sentences in a row land within 30% of the same length.
Fix: vary sentence length -- mix short and long.
```

## `Deslop.SignpostedConclusion`

```text
Level: warning
'%s' announces a conclusion instead of just concluding.
Fix: cut it, or fold the point into the final sentence directly.
```

## `Deslop.StaccatoFragments`

```text
Level: suggestion
3+ sentences in a row run 4 words or fewer.
Fix: this is a legitimate device in moderation -- use sparingly, or combine some fragments into full sentences.
```

## `Deslop.Subjectivity`

```text
Level: warning
'%s' asserts a value judgment instead of demonstrating one.
Fix: cut the adjective or replace it with the specific evidence that earns it.
Example: "a phenomenal improvement" becomes "a 40% cut in p99 latency."
```

## `Deslop.SuperficialParticiple`

```text
Level: warning
This trailing '-ing' clause asserts significance instead of showing it.
Fix: cut the clause, or replace it with the specific evidence that earns the claim.
```

## `Deslop.SweepingClaims`

```text
Level: suggestion
'%s' is an absolute claim asserted without evidence.
Fix: qualify it, or cite the specific evidence that supports it.
```

## `Deslop.ThroatClearing`

```text
Level: error
'%s' is throat-clearing before the actual point.
Fix: cut it and start with the point.
```

## `Deslop.TricolonAbstract`

```text
Level: suggestion
A three-abstract-noun list stands in for specifics.
Fix: name the actual three things, or cut to one concrete example.
```

## `Deslop.UnicodeDecoration`

```text
Level: error
Use plain ASCII ('%s') instead of the decorative Unicode character ('%s').
```

## `Deslop.VagueAttribution`

```text
Level: warning
'%s' attributes a claim to an unnamed authority.
Fix: name the actual source, or cut the claim.
```

## `Deslop.WhOpener`

```text
Level: suggestion
%d sentences in one paragraph open with a Wh- word.
Fix: vary the opener, or answer the question in the same paragraph.
```

## `Deslop.WordEcho`

```text
Level: suggestion
A word repeats 3+ times in one paragraph.
Fix: vary the vocabulary, or cut the repeats.
```
